modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Volaris's own pages disagree on the cabin-bag allowance, so only the personal-item rule is published here.

personal_item.value: 1 personal item, such as a backpack, handbag, briefcase or laptop case, up to 35 × 45 × 20 cm, placed under the seat in front of you.
personal_item.notes: Translated from the Spanish Volaris baggage policy page with Costa Rica selected; it is the Volaris brand's page, not one scoped to Volaris Costa Rica alone.

carryon_bag_dimensions.notes: The Costa Rica Spanish baggage-policy page and the English cabin-baggage page give different cabin-bag sizes.
conflicting_values: 1 cabin bag up to 55 × 40 × 25 cm (Costa Rica Spanish baggage policy page)
Up to 2 cabin bags of 22.4 x 15.7 x 12.9 inches each (English cabin-baggage page)

carryon_weight.notes: The two Volaris pages give different cabin weight limits.
conflicting_values: Cabin bag up to 10 kg; cabin bag and personal item together up to 20 kg (Costa Rica Spanish baggage policy page)
2 cabin bags must not weigh over 22 lbs. in total, including handbags and backpacks (English cabin-baggage page)

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Volaris sells three fare options, Zero, Básica and Plus; what is included depends on the option.

included_allowance.value: Checked baggage included in the fare: up to 15 kg or 25 kg depending on the fare purchased. The lowest-price option includes no carry-on or checked bag.
included_allowance.notes: Translated from the Spanish Volaris baggage policy page with Costa Rica selected; it is the Volaris brand's page, not one scoped to Volaris Costa Rica alone.

size_weight.value: Each checked bag up to 158 cm total (length + width + height). Bags bought separately: up to 25 kg each. With overweight charges, the maximum per bag is 45 kg.
size_weight.notes: Translated from the Spanish Volaris baggage policy page with Costa Rica selected; it is the Volaris brand's page, not one scoped to Volaris Costa Rica alone.

extra_bags.value: For an extra charge you can add up to 5 checked bags per passenger, each up to 25 kg and 158 cm.
extra_bags.notes: Translated from the Spanish Volaris baggage policy page with Costa Rica selected; it is the Volaris brand's page, not one scoped to Volaris Costa Rica alone.
